name: @taste-and-see/nest-audit
description: Shared admin-mutation audit emission for the Taste & See platform. `buildAuditActorContext` derives the actor + request metadata from a VERIFIED token (never the body), and `AuditEmitter` appends `audit.action_recorded` to the caller's transactional outbox INSIDE the mutation transaction, so a mutation that cannot be audited does not commit (CLAUDE.md §3.6, §5.3). Extracted verbatim from the three copies that had accumulated in service-ads, service-content, and service-trust-safety. TS-303b-followup-1.
